ogImage.label: Link preview picture
ogImage.help: The picture shown when a link to your shop is sent in WhatsApp or Facebook or found in search. Not set: no picture is added.

tagBadges.label: Tag badges on product cards
tagBadges.help: Which tag becomes the small badge on a product card, in what order, and with which words. Empty: the product's first tag, as before.

order.label: Collection order
order.help: Your own order of the collections in the admin list. Empty: by name.
